bio: Your Only Friend blends the laid-back feel of a neighborhood sandwich shop with the polish of a cocktail bar. The menu is cheeky—think sandwiches like the Hot Nug with chicken nuggets and Nashville hot sauce, the “Caul Me Maybe,” a roasted cauliflower number, or the Mortz & Mootz piled with mortadella, mozzarella and pickled red pepper jelly. Not everything is between the bread, and rotating specials might include blue cheese-brined wings with a crispy coating and their self-described strip mall-style garlic parm. Sides like Seattle fries and pimento dip, as well as bar snacks like miso Chex mix are a worthy order. The cocktail list is short but sharp, with drinks like the orange creamsicle-tasting Irish Cream Soda....
